known.title: Keep follow-ups on newly added files visible in Known issues

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - Round two leaves a non-P0 finding in a file added by the branch.
The new unmerged-state input still goes through `known_issues.collect(..., landed)`. Its filter at `src/forge/known_issues.py:101–102` removes findings whose files are absent from the default branch, so these follow-ups disappear from the board while close declares the change Ready. The new proof test exercises this problem: it introduces `app.py` only on the fix branch at `tests/test_two_round_limit.py:55`, then expects its findings in Known issues. Active findings need their files checked against the active branch.
